name: vtbl
meaning: points at Timer_vtbl 0x574350, whose single entry is the scalar deleting destructor 0x40b5d0. MSVC pads the vtable pointer to the class's 8-byte alignment (its LONGLONG members, /Zp8), so +0x04..+0x07 is compiler padding, never written

name: running
meaning: 1 between Timer_Start and Timer_Stop; GetDelta returns 0.0 and GetElapsed skips the TSC sample when it is 0

name: pad_0x0c
meaning: padding that aligns the three LONGLONGs to 8 bytes

name: baseTsc
meaning: TSC value captured by Timer_Start; Timer_OffsetBase shifts it to compensate for paused intervals

name: elapsedTsc
meaning: ticks from baseTsc to the last sample; returned by Timer_GetElapsed

name: deltaTsc
meaning: elapsedTsc minus the previous elapsedTsc, i.e. the ticks since the previous sample; returned by Timer_GetDelta. Exact 64-bit arithmetic, so no time is lost inside the timer.
